chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-'Abbas, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from 'Abd Allah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, from his forefathers, from 'Ali عليه السلام: that when he would come out from the privy, he would say:
All praise is for Allah, who gave me its pleasure, kept its strength in my body, and removed from me its harm. What a blessing these three are.

key_terms.أَذَاهُ: its harm, referring to harmful waste removed from the body
key_terms.اَلْحَمْدُ: praise and gratitude directed to Allah
key_terms.ثَلَاثًا: three, referring to the threefold blessing mentioned in the supplication
key_terms.قُوَّتَهُ: its strength or nourishment preserved in the body
key_terms.لَذَّتَهُ: its pleasure, meaning the enjoyment derived from food or drink
key_terms.نِعْمَةً: a blessing or favor from Allah

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Imam 'Ali عليه السلام say after coming out of the privy?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication attributed to Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali عليه السلام to be recited after leaving the privy. It expresses gratitude to Allah for three blessings in bodily relief: the enjoyment of nourishment, the retention of bodily strength, and the removal of harmful waste.
